steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.gear.climbing=true; const out=[]; for(const id of ['steps','stroll','crack','roof']){ const r=g.tors.route(id); g.player.place(r.base.x, r.base.z, 0); g.climbing.start(id); const C=g.climbing; const dirs=[[0,-1],[0.7,-0.7],[-0.7,-0.7],[1,0],[-1,0]]; let di=0; let stuck=0; let steps=0; let maxH=0; let minG=100; const wait=()=>C.resting&&C.grip<85; const inp={readLook:()=>({dx:0,dy:0}), readMove:()=>wait()?{x:0,y:0}:({x:dirs[di][0],y:dirs[di][1]}), takeTap:()=>null, pressed:(n)=>n==='primary'&&((C.state==='climb'&&C.grip<35&&C.chalkCool<=0)||(C.state==='hang'&&C.grip>60)), keyPressed:()=>false}; while(steps<6000 && C.state!=='top' && C.state!=='off'){ const before=C.hands.map(h=>h&&h.i).join(); C.update(0.05, inp); steps++; if(C.state==='climb') minG=Math.min(minG,C.grip); const after=C.hands.map(h=>h&&h.i).join(); if(C.moving||wait()) {stuck=0; continue;} if(before===after){ stuck++; if(stuck>12){ di=(di+1)%dirs.length; stuck=0; } } else { di=0; } if(C.hands[0]) maxH=Math.max(maxH, Math.max(...C.hands.filter(Boolean).map(h=>h.p.y-r.ground))); } const top=r.topY-r.ground; out.push(id+': '+C.state+' after '+(steps*0.05).toFixed(0)+' s, highest hold '+maxH.toFixed(1)+' of '+top.toFixed(1)+' m, lowest grip '+minG.toFixed(0)+', falls '+C.falls+', sent '+!!g.state.climb.sent[id]); if(C.state!=='top'&&C.state!=='off') C.finish('foot'); else { for(let i=0;i<60;i++) C.update(0.05, inp); } } return out.join(' | ')})()
